newsitem.title: USA: PTI Holding Q2 sales $9 mln, to take charge.
newsitem.headline: PTI Holding Q2 sales $9 mln, to take charge.

text.p: NOTE: Figures in millions except percentage.
Quarter is three months ended June 30.
Full company name is PTI Holdings Inc.
Note: The company said it looks for continued growth in its existing sporting goods products during the second half of 1997.
The company also said it expects a one-time non-cash charge to earnings of about $2 million because of shares that will be issued sales reach $20 million.
The company said this charge will not affect the cash flow nor shareholders' equity in the aggregate.
In effect, the accounting entries will be a debit to retained earnings through the income statement and a credit to paid-in capital.

The convertible preferred A shares were issued to all shareholders prior to PTI's initial public offering in 1992, in connection with a reverse stock split, to compensate them when PTI attained goals set by the underwriter.
One of those goals was the attainment of sales of $20 million for fiscal year 1997.
The company said this goal "will almost certainly be met" in 1997, and will result in the issuance of 250,000 shares of common stock.
Of these 250,000 shares to be issued, 235,516 will go to shareholders who were part of management at the time of the IPO.
